info.name: Qiskit Runtime Analytics API
info.description:
Read usage analytics and active workloads for a Qiskit Runtime instance, including by-time-window aggregations used to track Open / Pay-as-you-go / Flex / Premium minute consumption.

Contact Support:
 Name: IBM Quantum
